title: Standing rules R1-R9
summary: R1 (Tom Dyer, 25 Nov 2026 15:04, "agreed re cats2 entirely"): Everything inside cats2 (ed209l), including rebooting and deallocating it, is approved. Keys and the Auth, the Azure network security group, and every other node are not. An order changing only cats2 cites R1 and needs no separate approval; anything outside it still needs Tom directly; an agent unsure asks Tom. R2: port 22 on cats2 closes only when cats2 can be rebuilt from its image with nobody logging in and the Azure serial console works as break-glass; cats1 keeps port 22 until SSH over XTP survives a reboot. R3: kits built in the Ubuntu 22.04 build container; image = stock Ubuntu minimal plus a first-boot script that installs kits and applies the contract; no build tools on cats; contract versioned in the image; enforcing boot never disables the controller dependencies. R4: controllers advertise capacity, a cluster arbitrator (main and spare on separate sites) decides; no bidding without a decider. R5: recover cats2 by rebuild, not repair; offline suites are regression, not a ladder. R6 (Tom Dyer, 25 Nov 2026 16:17, "We can use ed209k as well", narrow reading written by Claude (Opus 5.5)): installing and running xtpd, an LDAP role (main or spare), their kits from the repository and their files inside ed209k is approved for the grid push; rebooting ed209k, keys and the Auth, Vultr account and firewall settings, and anything else on ed209k are not. R7 (Tom Dyer, 25 Nov 2026 17:11, "Agreed regarding rolling witness"): the witness is a role held by a node that is neither main nor spare, and it rolls to another node outside the pair when the pair moves; with no such node left, there is no promotion, the spare stays STALE and the event is logged. Installing and running xtpd and the witness service inside cats1 (ed209g) is approved; port 22 on cats1, rebooting cats1, keys and the Auth, the NSG and anything else on cats1 are not. R8 (Tom Dyer, 25 Nov 2026 19:35; port amended 21:30): ed209k accepts XTP over UDP on the commissioned port 62801 from cats2 (20.118.224.14) as a backup carrier; every ed209 machine accepts XTP (IP protocol 36 and UDP 62801) from Tom's workstation 82.68.79.12, which sends XTP out; each machine is inventoried read-only first and changed per its host and cloud firewall; port 22 rules are never touched under R8. R8 status, 27 Nov 2026: the cloud side is done (order E, REQ-00006325, Tom's direct yes): every cloud firewall holds the additions, no source was removed. R9 (Tom Dyer, 27 Nov 2026 15:03 "you have a machine to play with", "continue" 15:16 to Claude's wording): everything inside ED209M (newyork1.rasenfalcon.com, 185.195.106.30, Clouvider VPS.16 New York, AlmaLinux 10.3, nested KVM) is approved: installing, configuring, running VMs and rebooting its guest OS; keys and the Auth (including the SSH host key, sshd settings and any mailbox credential), the Clouvider panel and its network settings, the host firewall's port 22 rule, and every other node are not. An order changing only ED209M cites R9; firewall rules elsewhere that admit ED209M are R8 work and need Tom directly. Recovery of ED209M is by nuke and rebuild with the node deployer; its MIs are located elsewhere.
authority: plan agreed by Tom Dyer (continue, 25 Nov 2026 15:04); hitlist Claude (Fable 5.2); review and writing Claude (Opus 5.5)
